scripts.dev: npm run build -w @health/shared && concurrently -k -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w @health/api" "npm run dev -w @health/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @health/shared && npm run build -w @health/api && npm run build -w @health/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @health/shared && npm run typecheck -w @health/shared && npm run typecheck -w @health/api && npm run typecheck -w @health/web
